title: Design, synthesis, spectroscopic characterizations, single crystal X-ray analysis, in vitro xanthine oxidase and acetylcholinesterase inhibitory evaluation as well as in silico evaluation of selenium-based N-heterocyclic carbene compounds.
authors: Kaya, Gulsen; Noma, Samir Abbas Ali; Barut Celepci, Duygu; Bayil, Imren; Taskin-Tok, Tugba; Gok, Yetkin; Ates, Burhan; Aktas, Aydin; Aygun, Muhittin; Tezcan, Burcu
one_liner_zh: 该文合成硒基NHC化合物并评估其对AChE/XO酶的抑制及DNA结合，虽含对接和MD模拟，但核心是酶抑制而非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题关联弱。
abstract: Herein, eight new NHC-based selenourea derivatives were synthesized and characterized by using spectroscopic method ((1)H, (19)F, and (13)C NMR, FT-IR), and elemental analysis techniques. These compounds were synthesized by mixing benzimidazolium salts, potassium carbonate, and selenium powder in ethyl alcohol. Additionally, the molecular and crystal structures of the three compounds (1c, 2b, and 2c) were determined using the single-crystal x-ray diffraction (XRD) method. Diffraction analysis demonstrated the partial carbon-selenium double-bond character of these compounds. All compounds were determined to be highly potent inhibitors for AChE and XO enzymes. The IC(50) values for the compounds were found in the range of 0.361-0.754 muM for XO and from 0.995 to 1.746 muM for AChE. The DNA binding properties of the compounds were investigated. These compounds did not have a remarkable DNA binding property. Also, DPPH radical scavenging activities of the compounds were also investigated. Compounds (1c), (2a), (3a), and (3b) exhibited more pronounced DPPH radical scavenging activity when compared to other compounds. Docking studies were applied by using AutoDock 4 to determine interaction mechanism of the selected compounds (1a), (1b), and (3b). The compound (1b) has good binding affinity (-9.78 kcal/mol) against AChE, and (-6.86 kcal/mol) for XO target. Drug similarity properties of these compounds compared to positive controls were estimated and evaluated by ADMET analysis. Furthermore, molecular dynamics simulations have been applied to understand the accuracy of docking studies. These findings and the defined compounds could be potential candidates for the discovery and progress of effective medicine(s) for AChE and XO in the future.Communicated by Ramaswamy H. Sarma.
abstract_zh: 在此，合成了八种新型基于NHC的硒脲衍生物，并通过光谱方法（(1)H、(19)F和(13)C NMR、FT-IR）及元素分析技术进行了表征。这些化合物是通过将苯并咪唑盐、碳酸钾和硒粉在乙醇中混合而合成的。此外，利用单晶X射线衍射（XRD）方法确定了三种化合物（1c、2b和2c）的分子和晶体结构。衍射分析表明这些化合物具有部分碳-硒双键特征。所有化合物均被确定为AChE和XO酶的高效抑制剂。这些化合物对XO的IC(50)值范围为0.361-0.754 μM，对AChE的IC(50)值范围为0.995至1.746 μM。研究了化合物的DNA结合性质，发现这些化合物没有显著的DNA结合能力。同时，也研究了化合物的DPPH自由基清除活性。与其他化合物相比，化合物（1c）、（2a）、（3a）和（3b）表现出更明显的DPPH自由基清除活性。利用AutoDock 4进行了对接研究，以确定所选化合物（1a）、（1b）和（3b）的相互作用机制。化合物（1b）对AChE具有良好的结合亲和力（-9.78 kcal/mol），对XO靶点的结合亲和力为（-6.86 kcal/mol）。通过ADMET分析评估了这些化合物与阳性对照相比的药物相似性。此外，进行了分子动力学模拟以验证对接研究的准确性。这些发现和所定义的化合物可能成为未来发现和开发针对AChE和XO的有效药物的潜在候选物。由Ramaswamy H. Sarma通讯。
